# Use light-dark for paired theme colors with explicit scheme and retained exceptional states

The accepted CSS migration combines ordinary light/dark color pairs with light-dark() and places color-scheme: light dark where the affected document needs it. Preserve high contrast/media rules and hover/selected state distinctions. A2024 Windows11 review caught missing tab behavior even though the syntax conversion looked plausible. Omit two-branch variations where the colors are identical. Inspect current local variable families: Calendar legacy camelCase and newer component-prefixed kebab families coexist; this batch does not justify renaming all variables or imposing one spelling repository-wide.

Scope: theme/colors.

Paths:

- `calendar/base/themes/common/calendar-views.css`
- `calendar/base/themes/common/widgets/minimonth.css`
- `mail/themes/shared/mail/layout.css`
- `mail/themes/shared/mail/tabmail.css`
